name: WordPress
summary: WordPress with Caddy, PHP 8.3 and MariaDB. Optional domain with HTTPS.
getting_started: Open /wp-admin/ at your server address and sign in with the admin login shown once. The login is also stored on the server in /root/.beltoft-app/credentials.json. Add a domain for HTTPS. Configure SMTP on port 587 before relying on site email. Set up a backup plan before making changes. You keep WordPress, plugins and themes up to date yourself.
